verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no subpage or site-crawl capability. The closest approximation is restricting search results to a whole domain or a path prefix (includeDomains), then pulling clean content for the returned URLs through the Contents API or inline in Search. That is a search-scoped workaround, not crawling outward from a result. Missing for 10: any documented subpage/link-following crawl from a seed URL, controls for crawl depth or page count, whole-site crawl coverage, and hands-on corroboration.
